entities.summary: Giancarlo Ghironzi was a Sammarinese physician and statesman who served as Captain Regent from 1 April to 1 October 1961, and from 1 October 1969 to 1 April 1970. A member of the Sammarinese Christian Democratic Party, he previously served as Secretary for Foreign and Political Affairs from 1972 to 1973 and from 1976 to 1978.
